plugins.photosPermission: Hindsite needs access to your photos so you can attach them to events.
plugins.cameraPermission: Hindsite uses the camera to scan documents for your moments.
plugins.microphonePermission: Hindsite uses the microphone to record voice notes for your moments.

ios.activationRule: SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.movie" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text").@count >= 1).@count >= 1

plugins.microphonePermission: Hindsite uses the microphone to record voice notes for your moments.
